annotations.title: Is this a good time? (decision timing)

description:
Use this when the user asks whether now, or a particular date or range, is a good time for a decision such as changing jobs, marrying or investing. It takes tens of seconds.
The interpret verdict for `domain`, voiced by a language model as an answer to a decision `question`, read at `targetDate` (or the start of `dateRange`, or today when neither is sent): the verdict, the running daśā and eventTiming are taken at that day. A malformed or pre-birth date is refused with 400 (`invalid_target_date`, `invalid_date_range`). Expect tens of seconds; set a client timeout of at least 90 s.
Cost: 7 credits per call (only successful calls are charged; a sandbox key is free and returns a fixed sample).
Voiced by a language model: allow up to 90 seconds.
Example arguments: {"birthData":{"date":"1990-05-12","time":"14:35","timezone":"Asia/Kolkata","latitude":28.6139,"longitude":77.209},"domain":"career","question":"Should I accept the offer?","targetDate":"2026-11-15"}

birthData.description: The person's birth data: date, local time (omit if unknown), IANA timezone, latitude and longitude.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM or HH:MM:SS, local to `timezone`. Omit if unknown: house-dependent detail is then reduced.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the birthplace, e.g. Asia/Kolkata.

dateRange.description: Optional period the decision is about: start and end dates, YYYY-MM-DD. The verdict is read at `start`; `end` must not precede it.

domain.description: Life area the decision is about, e.g. career, marriage, finance or health.

question.description: The decision question in plain language, e.g. "Is this a good time to change jobs?"

targetDate.description: Optional date the decision is about, YYYY-MM-DD. The verdict is read at this day. Takes precedence over `dateRange`.

name: resolve_timing

CorpusResolution.description: How the classical evidence on this chart leans, as counts. Never source names on this surface.

requestId.description: Quote this in any support request.

sandbox.description: Present and true only on sandbox-key responses: a fixed sample, not computed from your request.

classicalSources.description: Titles of the classical texts the domain is grounded in. Omitted until validated.

referenceDate.description: The day the verdict, the daśā reading and eventTiming are anchored to: `targetDate` when sent, else `dateRange.start`, else the day of the call.

remaining_credits.description: Your one-time free credits left plus the paid balance, after this call.
